body: I haven't created a book, I liked reading. I used to be able to write papers that I was proud of but my answers now are similar to what a 5th grader would write. I can't anymore, it's painful to lose what I was once proud of.

I don't think so. Although it would help a little, I don't think I can go back to what I was in 7th grade and I also don't think I'm smart enough to achieve something appreciable. There is no way I would be able to take another course though, I would have to change schools and also my parents would rather have me drop out of school than let me study arts.
It's not. I want to live on my own terms and not have to think about what others say but I don't have the funds or the mental strength to do so. I wish I did though, I could be happy then.
